protocol.description: Request contract the worker speaks. custom = POST /generate (flat body) → { url }. runpod = POST /runsync or /run with { input: { kind, prompt, image_urls, audio_url, video_url, model, duration, resolution } }; output URL read from RunPod response shape.

worker_role.description: Optional role / model tag for display and routing hints. One of: comfyui (image/upscale), kling (video), lipsync, motion (video).

runpod_sync.description: When protocol=runpod, use /runsync (synchronous) instead of /run + poll

last_probe_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent health probe (manual Ping or the automatic sweep in checkGPUWorkerHealth), regardless of outcome.

last_probe_ok.description: Result of the most recent health probe: true = healthy/reachable, false = unhealthy or unreachable, NULL = never probed.

last_probe_detail.description: Human-readable extra info from the last probe (e.g. RunPod ready/unhealthy worker counts).

last_probe_error.description: Error message from the last probe when it failed or was unreachable; NULL when the last probe succeeded.

paused_reason.description: Why a paused/draining worker is in that state: 'auto' = the health sweep paused it after a failed probe, 'admin' = an admin explicitly paused/drained it. NULL when active or for legacy pauses predating this column.
